knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Waste is removed first so that spills made while emptying do not land on surfaces already cleaned.
Polish goes on last because splashes from the wet work would mark a polish applied earlier.
The area is cleared first, then vacuumed, then mopped from the far end toward the exit.

practicalCriteria: Empties the bin and seats a new liner before any wiping begins.
Works the room from the far side toward the exit, using the colour-coded cloths for each zone.
Mops with signs placed and furniture cleared, and removes the sign only once the floor has dried.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Job record or photo of the finished area
stopWorkCriteria: Food residue wiped with a cloth that has already been used on a dirty zone
Wet floor left at an entrance without a sign
